name: Local media generation
summary: Makes pictures, sound and video on this computer, so in Combined mode they are made here and not in the cloud.

requires.why: To talk to ComfyUI on a local port, and to search community workflow sources when you ask it to.
To save the pictures it makes. They are deleted when you delete this plugin.
To start ComfyUI, and to install a workflow’s node packs into Alexia’s own ComfyUI with its own Python.
To download ComfyUI, models and node packs from GitHub, Hugging Face and the Comfy registry, after you press Install.
To read the workflow file you exported from ComfyUI, so it can be saved where ComfyUI keeps them. It only ever reads.
To edit the pictures you attach — kept with their conversation, read only while an edit runs, and deleted with it.

operations.summary: Render pictures, sound or video from a prepared ComfyUI workflow
Read the workflow library on this computer, and write down a workflow somebody asked for
Edit a picture with a verified editing model, checked before anything is shown

settings.label: Picture program address
settings.hint: Where ComfyUI, the program that makes the pictures, is listening. Leave it as it is unless you started it on another port.

settings.label: Where the picture program is installed
settings.hint: The ComfyUI folder, with main.py in it. Leave it empty and Alexia looks in the usual places.

settings.label: Start the picture program when a picture is asked for
settings.hint: It takes about a minute the first time and stays running afterwards. Off means you start it yourself.

settings.label: Model
settings.hint: Any part of the model’s file name is enough: hassaku finds hassakuXLIllustrious_v22. Leave it empty to use whichever is installed. Ask Alexia to list them.

settings.label: Steps
settings.hint: More steps is slower and usually better, up to a point. Twenty-five suits most models.

settings.label: Fix black pictures on smaller graphics cards
settings.hint: Turn this on if pictures come out black. It uses the full-precision VAE, which SDXL needs on many 8 GB cards, and a little more graphics memory.

settings.label: Search community workflows
settings.hint: What to look for in community workflow sources. What is found appears in Workflows below, where it can be installed.

widgets.label: Made here
widgets.hint: Everything this machine has made, newest first. Nothing is ever deleted to make room — the size below is what that costs. Click one to see what made it.

widgets.label: Workflows
widgets.hint: By task — background removal, upscaling, image edit, inpaint, face restore, style transfer, speech, voice cloning, image to video. Each card says what it needs, its size and whether it fits the graphics card of the computer that renders. Install sets everything up there: the workflow, its models and its node packs. A ComfyUI you installed yourself is never changed — you are told what to add instead.
